_about: Outside calorie references per template serving, checked by check_template_calories.py after every matcher run. kcal is the reference normalised to OUR serving (null when none is usable). status: ok (a printed figure, divided to our serving: an independent check), recipe_match (a real recipe's own amounts run through our rows, or its printed figure rescaled to our main-ingredient amount: checks our amounts, not our calorie data), serving_differs, not_comparable (the reason is in note), none. See RECIPE_RULES.md, 'Calorie reference'. First filled by the 11-13 Nov 2026 audit; split into ok and recipe_match 25 Nov 2026 (Arianna).
